title: Cache leg lengths on a mutable Track
prompt: `Track.leg_lengths_km()` recomputes every great-circle distance each time it is called, and summarising a track calls it more than once. Cache the leg lengths so that a summary computes each leg's distance only once, without changing any results.

setup.old: - **Distance** is great-circle distance on a sphere of radius 6371.0088 km.
setup.new:
- **Distance** is great-circle distance on a sphere of radius 6371.0088 km.
- A `Track` is mutable: you can append to, replace or edit `track.points`, and its
  lengths always reflect the current points.

edits.new:
points: list[Point] = field(default_factory=list)
    _legs_key: tuple[Point, ...] | None = field(
        default=None, init=False, repr=False, compare=False
    )
    _legs: list[float] = field(
        default_factory=list, init=False, repr=False, compare=False
    )

points: list[Point] = field(default_factory=list)
    _legs: list[float] | None = field(
        default=None, init=False, repr=False, compare=False
    )
